title: Row-owner embedding staged component measurements
measurement_scope: Five serial eight-rank component stages using the captured production B2x4096 first-microbatch IDs; no full training step or TPS measurement.

input.description: Eight distinct rank-local input ID tensors captured from the corrected production-data native run; harness rechecked each tensor hash after load.

timers.cuda_elapsed_span_ms: CUDA event span joined across the compute, all-gather, and reduce-scatter streams; includes queue gaps/waits and is not the sum of kernel durations.
timers.host_call_ms: Python, dispatch, autograd, host work, submissions, and internal host waits within the call.
timers.host_end_sync_ms: Endpoint synchronization wait after the joined event is recorded.
timers.synchronized_wall_ms: Host wall time from call start through endpoint synchronization; overlaps the CUDA span and host-call scope.

measurement_protocol.measurement_boundaries: Gradient zeroing and barriers are outside timed calls; forward and backward are separate, integrated is ordinary model(ids).backward(gradient); integrated excludes full lm_head compute. One additional profiled forward/backward pair follows timing and is not mixed into samples.
measurement_protocol.memory: Absolute per-rank peak allocated/reserved bytes reset before each timed call; resident GFSDP storage is included. Per-sample allocator retry/OOM deltas are retained.
measurement_protocol.compiler_cache_policy: Reuse the validated D cache; TorchInductor cache is common and Triton cache is rank-local, as recorded per rank.
measurement_protocol.rank_max_definition: For each sample, take the maximum across eight ranks, then report the median/min/max and full ten-value sequence. Rank-local medians are retained separately; ranks and stream durations are never summed.

observations_and_limits.warmup: The first instrumented warmup was a multi-second outlier in every stage. Warmups 2–10 and the ten measured samples are retained by rank; their medians/last values are included in each stage summary.
observations_and_limits.cache_warning: D0 and D1 launcher logs contain torch._vendor.quack .o-loader/cache fallback messages that selected in-process compilation without disk cache. The same validated cache paths were used throughout; D2–D4 logs had no matching Quack message. No changes were made to force cache behavior.
observations_and_limits.runtime_warnings: Launcher logs are retained. c10d emitted address-family socket warnings in successful runs; all ranks completed and outputs were written. These warnings did not create a failed process group.
observations_and_limits.native_fp32_partial_scratch_note: The source-derived example tensor sizes above are not instrumented allocation sizes. The native API does not expose exact internal allocation, allocator lifetime, or peak contribution; the harness retains native_fp32_partial_scratch_bytes=null. Measured allocator peaks remain the primary memory evidence.
observations_and_limits.host_gaps: No standalone host-gap attribution is emitted. The reports retain per-stage host-context call times, profiler event interval unions/first-to-last spans, and the full per-rank Chrome traces.
observations_and_limits.profiling: Profiler spans and event unions are diagnostic only and may include wait/host effects. Timed component spans are from the separate unprofiled samples. Kernel-duration sums and overlapping streams are not summed into elapsed time.
observations_and_limits.comparison_limit: One fixed-order D0→D1→D2→D3→D4 component series was run. There is no A/A noise estimate, reversed order, or repeated variant. Stage-to-stage medians are descriptive and do not establish causal performance or a general effect.
observations_and_limits.throughput_limit: Component timings do not establish native update throughput, convergence, or full-model critical-path performance.

native_fp32_partial_source_derived_examp.classification: source-derived tensor sizes from the pinned PyTorch dispatch/kernels; not measured allocation or allocator peak
